verdict.rationale: TruffleHog supports continuous, unattended background operation via hosted/self-hosted scanners that monitor sources (Git, Jira, Slack, Confluence, etc.) and route alerts to Slack/Jira/webhooks, plus pre-commit/pre-receive hooks for automated gating — this covers 'runs autonomously in the background' in a security-scanning sense. However, there is no evidence of AI-agent-specific orchestration, scheduling APIs, or agentic workflow tooling beyond continuous scanning/alerting.
